findings.one_line: The latent FID-S trichotomy promised by the proposal is not delivered: this node expressly leaves the grammar, latent independent-source lift, rational witnesses, formula reconstruction, and global bounds open, while the proved kernel is restricted to the fully observed case and an abstract conditional ID embedding.

The headline algorithmic-identification deliverable has no executable production system, terminal-certificate syntax, or computable formula/witness output; construction handles and an open-ended question cannot supply the required support-valid FID-S map.

This proposition assumes the concrete grammar, matching seven-case transitions, compiler equations, and provenance interface whose construction is the contribution, so without an instantiated FID-S it is a conditional verification schema rather than a theorem-level advance over ordinary ID.

The actual fully observed completion criterion is the note's strongest delivered theorem, but it lacks a precise theorem-level comparison to the closest positivity/support-identification literature; several bibliography entries have no relevance sentence, so novelty for the delivered rather than intended kernel is not established.
